{"markdown": "Outcomes analysis compares the recomputed model outputs with the realized outcomes on the development and holdout splits, and this section reviews those results for reasonableness and appropriateness relative to the model's stated objective [[reg:SR26-2:V.1.b]].
The observed event rate on test is 0.2212 [[art:f60ae2a7:metrics.test.event_rate]], which is above the declared rule value of 0.05 [[art:42f1351e:rule.calibration_first_event_rate]] below which this report would present calibration ahead of discrimination, so discrimination is reported first and calibration follows.

### Discrimination and fit by split

| Metric | Train | Test |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Observations | 21000 [[art:1721ceae:metrics.train.n]] | 9000 [[art:5367a59f:metrics.test.n]] |
| Event rate | 0.2212 [[art:657aa7fc:metrics.train.event_rate]] | 0.2212 [[art:f60ae2a7:metrics.test.event_rate]] |
| AUC | 0.7546 [[art:01cf8178:metrics.train.auc]] | 0.755 [[art:365b7034:metrics.test.auc]] |
| Gini | 0.5091 [[art:eaaf0f79:metrics.train.gini]] | 0.51 [[art:296bfeeb:metrics.test.gini]] |
| KS | 0.4144 [[art:18df22bd:metrics.train.ks]] | 0.4067 [[art:d3c4ed61:metrics.test.ks]] |
| Log loss | 0.4439 [[art:b816b083:metrics.train.logloss]] | 0.4442 [[art:2de58c1b:metrics.test.logloss]] |
| Brier | 0.1384 [[art:c95106e9:metrics.train.brier]] | 0.1385 [[art:86e93c8f:metrics.test.brier]] |
| Mean predicted | 0.2212 [[art:935d2cb7:metrics.train.mean_predicted]] | 0.2206 [[art:89d241ea:metrics.test.mean_predicted]] |

Rank-ordering is set out by decile of predicted probability on the holdout split, with the highest predicted probabilities in the first decile.

[[table:deciles.test]]

The share of events falling in the top pair of deciles is 0.5031 [[art:5131afa7:deciles.train.top2_capture]] on train and 0.4952 [[art:e2c0ad9f:deciles.test.top2_capture]] on test, so the concentration of events at the top of the score distribution carries over to the holdout split with only a slight reduction.

### Train-to-test gap

AUC is 0.7546 [[art:01cf8178:metrics.train.auc]] on train and 0.755 [[art:365b7034:metrics.test.auc]] on test, and the declared cap on the train-to-test AUC gap is 0.08 [[art:630f28f4:threshold.O1.auc_gap]].
Because test AUC is not below train AUC, the gap does not approach that cap, and the ordering of the two values gives no evidence of overfitting on this measure.
KS is marginally lower on test than on train, and log loss and Brier are marginally higher on test than on train, which is the direction expected from a holdout split and is small in relation to the gap tolerance above.

### Calibration

The logistic regression of the outcome on the model logit gives a slope of 0.9886 [[art:e06564c7:calibration_slope.test]] on test and 1.001 [[art:85461245:calibration_slope.train]] on train, against a declared band running from 0.8 [[art:749634ae:threshold.C1.calibration_slope.min]] to 1.2 [[art:b6672579:threshold.C1.calibration_slope.max]].
The corresponding intercept is -0.008632 [[art:2ee976d3:calibration_intercept.test]] on test and 0.0003779 [[art:2ce8cd09:calibration_intercept.train]] on train, so neither split shows a material level shift in the predicted log odds.
Mean predicted probability on test is 0.2206 [[art:89d241ea:metrics.test.mean_predicted]] against an observed event rate of 0.2212 [[art:f60ae2a7:metrics.test.event_rate]].
The relative gap between the two is 0.002944 [[art:bae28fd6:calibration.mean_rel_gap.test]] on test and 0.0001555 [[art:a03ea014:calibration.mean_rel_gap.train]] on train, against a declared tolerance of 0.25 [[art:20e93a8c:threshold.C1.mean_ratio_rel]].
Both splits therefore sit well inside the tolerance on aggregate level, and the decile view below shows how predicted and observed rates track across the range of predicted probability.

[[table:calibration.test]]

### Developer-declared thresholds

| Rule | Bound | Observed value | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AUC on test, minimum | 0.7 [[art:8bfd02cc:threshold.package.auc.test.min]] | 0.755 [[art:365b7034:metrics.test.auc]] | Pass |
| Brier on test, maximum | 0.2 [[art:d0f98b9c:threshold.package.brier.test.max]] | 0.1385 [[art:86e93c8f:metrics.test.brier]] | Pass |
| Calibration slope on test, minimum | 0.8 [[art:95fdb848:threshold.package.calibration_slope.test.min]] | 0.9886 [[art:e06564c7:calibration_slope.test]] | Pass |
| Calibration slope on test, maximum | 1.2 [[art:0adb7a89:threshold.package.calibration_slope.test.max]] | 0.9886 [[art:e06564c7:calibration_slope.test]] | Pass |
| PSI, maximum | 0.25 [[art:fbb5a9d1:threshold.package.psi.max]] | no PSI value is present in the artifacts for this section | Not evaluated here |
| Wall-clock seconds, maximum | 300 [[art:3f4c6e97:threshold.package.max_seconds]] | no runtime value is present in the artifacts for this section | Not evaluated here |

The two rows marked as not evaluated here are reported elsewhere in this report and are listed only so that the developer-declared set is shown in full.
On the outcomes measures that this section can evaluate, the model meets each declared bound, and the guidance's trigger for adjustment, recalibration, or redevelopment on persistent deviation outside established thresholds is not engaged by these results [[reg:SR26-2:V.1.b]].
The analysis rests on in-sample and holdout comparison rather than on out-of-time back-testing, which the superseded guidance treats as a distinct form of outcomes analysis that holdout analysis does not substitute for [[reg:SR11-7:V.1.c]].
"}
